definition.interpretation: Experiment exp-divergent-values-006 evaluated hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-002 revision 2 using numeric observation on divergence over stochastic trajectories. The outcome was inconclusive (final divergence metric 1.715 >= 0.1), confirming that stochastic environmental inputs generate divergence from identical initial states, but leaving the precise permanent threshold uncertain.
definition.limitations: Limited by simple random walk simulations and reliance on heuristic stochastic noise models rather than full cognitive architectures.
definition.next_step: Revise hypothesis to specify bounds on divergence growth rate and test sensitivity to varying stochastic noise amplitudes.
